description_en: Retrieves a list of traffic statistics
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-traffic-statistics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --traffic-statistic-period 30 --traffic-statistic-period-type day --traffic-statistic-type Region --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --traffic-type agentAnalysisLogTraffic --region-tag 1 --log-user-ids 1733260000000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTrafficStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on the location of your asset. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your asset is in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your asset is outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response messages. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. This parameter is used by an administrator to switch to the perspective of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The statistic granularity. Valid values:

day: day. This is the default value.

hour: hour
parameters.help_zh:
统计粒度。取值：
day：天，默认。
hour：小时
parameters.name: traffic_statistic_period_type

parameters.help_en:
The statistic dimension. Valid values:

Region

Product

DataIngetion

logUserId
parameters.help_zh:
统计维度。取值：
Region
Product
DataIngetion
logUserId
parameters.name: traffic_statistic_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the log traffic
parameters.name: traffic_type

parameters.help_en: A list of user IDs for batch data ingestion
parameters.help_zh: 数据批量接入用户ID列表
parameters.name: log_user_ids
